blocks.zh: 預防應對計劃與利害關係人管理
blocks.en: Prevention and Response Plan and Stakeholder Management

blocks.zh: 本節內容導覽
blocks.en: Section Overview

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 說明藥品短缺預防與應對計劃（Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan）的五大核心組成要素，以及其如何形成持續運作的循環機制。
blocks.en: Describe the five core elements of the Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan and how they form a continuously operating cycle.

blocks.zh: 理解端對端（E2E）價值鏈（從原料到病患）在藥品短缺風險識別中的關鍵作用，並能解釋 CDMO 作為供應鏈節點的責任定位。
blocks.en: Understand the critical role of the end-to-end (E2E) value chain (from raw materials to patients) in identifying drug shortage risks, and explain the CDMO's responsibilities as a node in the supply chain.

blocks.zh: 引用美國《聯邦食品、藥品及化妝品法》第 506C 條及歐盟 GMP 指南第 13 條關於 MAH 法定通報義務的核心要求。
blocks.en: Cite the core requirements for the MAH's statutory notification obligations under Section 506C of the US Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act and Article 13 of the EU GMP guidelines.

blocks.zh: 整理向衛生主管機關通報短缺事件所需的三大類關鍵資訊（病患資訊、配銷資訊、庫存資訊），並能計算庫存天數（Days of Supply）。
blocks.en: Compile the three categories of key information needed to notify health authorities of a shortage (patient information, distribution information, and stock information), and calculate Days of Supply.

blocks.zh: 分析衛生主管機關在短缺事件中的四類決策情境，特別是「缺陷產品繼續使用」與「無產品可用」的臨床利益風險權衡。
blocks.en: Analyze the four categories of health authority decision scenarios in a shortage event, especially the clinical benefit-risk trade-off between continued use of a defective product and having no product available.

blocks.zh: 藥品短缺預防與應對計劃 — 概述
blocks.en: Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan: Overview

blocks.zh: 中文解析：為什麼需要這份計劃？
blocks.en: Commentary: Why Is This Plan Needed?

blocks.zh: 核心定義：Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan
blocks.en: Core Definition: Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan

blocks.zh: 這是一份以產品為單位的整合性框架文件，同時涵蓋：
blocks.en: This is an integrated, product-specific framework document that covers both:

blocks.zh: 主動預防（Proactive）：提前識別風險、建立韌性
blocks.en: Proactive prevention: identifying risks early and building resilience

blocks.zh: 被動應對（Reactive）：發生短缺時的應急流程
blocks.en: Reactive response: emergency procedures when a shortage occurs

blocks.zh: 未來可能以「Shortage Prevention Plan」或「Mitigation Plan」命名，實質內容相同。
blocks.en: In the future it may be named a "Shortage Prevention Plan" or "Mitigation Plan"; the substance is the same.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：哪些產品「必須」有此計劃？
blocks.en: Key Point: Which Products Must Have This Plan?

blocks.zh: 必須（Should proactively develop）：醫療必需品、維生用藥、生命支持用藥
blocks.en: Should proactively develop: medically necessary products, life-sustaining drugs, and life-supporting drugs

blocks.zh: 建議（Can also benefit）：中等風險、急性或慢性病用藥 — 尤其當 Risk Triage 顯示 Risk Priority Level 1
blocks.en: Can also benefit: moderate-risk products and drugs for acute or chronic conditions, especially where the Risk Triage indicates Risk Priority Level 1

blocks.zh: 在衛生主管機關稽查時，此計劃應主動揭露，展示廠商的風險管理成熟度。
blocks.en: During health authority inspections, the plan should be proactively disclosed to demonstrate the manufacturer's risk management maturity.

blocks.zh: 比喻：藥品短缺計劃如同「颱風應變計劃」
blocks.en: Analogy: A Drug Shortage Plan Is Like a "Typhoon Response Plan"

blocks.zh: 平時（非颱風季）就要備妥疏散路線、物資清單、聯絡電話；颱風來臨時才能有條不紊應對。Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan 就是製藥廠的「供應鏈颱風應變計劃」——不是危機發生後才臨時抱佛腳，而是提前建立、定期演練、隨時更新。
blocks.en: Evacuation routes, supply checklists, and contact numbers must be ready in normal times (outside typhoon season) so that you can respond in an orderly way when a typhoon arrives. The Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan is the pharmaceutical company's "supply chain typhoon response plan": it is not something improvised after a crisis hits, but is built in advance, rehearsed regularly, and kept up to date.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的特殊角色
blocks.en: The Special Role of the CDMO

blocks.zh: CDMO（合約研發製造機構）在此計劃中是關鍵供應鏈節點。當 MAH（上市許可持有人）制定本計劃時，CDMO 應主動提供以下資訊：
blocks.en: The CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organization) is a critical supply chain node in this plan. When the MAH (marketing authorization holder) develops the plan, the CDMO should proactively provide the following information:

blocks.zh: 自身產能狀況與瓶頸（Capacity bottlenecks）
blocks.en: Its own capacity status and bottlenecks (capacity bottlenecks)

blocks.zh: 原料及關鍵物料的供應風險
blocks.en: Supply risks for raw materials and critical materials

blocks.zh: 備用製程或供應商切換方案
blocks.en: Alternate process or supplier switching options

blocks.zh: CDMO 若被動等待指令，可能造成計劃中存在「盲點」，導致短缺風險被低估。
blocks.en: If the CDMO passively waits for instructions, the plan may contain "blind spots", leading to underestimation of shortage risk.

blocks.zh: 預防與應對計劃的五大組成要素
blocks.en: The Five Elements of the Prevention and Response Plan

blocks.zh: 中文解析：五大組成要素詳解
blocks.en: Commentary: The Five Elements in Detail

blocks.zh: 要素 1：識別危害 — Drug Shortage Risk Register
blocks.en: Element 1: Identify Hazards - Drug Shortage Risk Register

blocks.zh: 這是整個計劃的起點。透過端對端（E2E）風險評估，涵蓋價值鏈中的製造、儲存、運輸等環節，系統性列出所有潛在短缺風險來源，形成「藥品短缺風險登記冊（Risk Register）」。
blocks.en: This is the starting point of the whole plan. Through an end-to-end (E2E) risk assessment covering manufacturing, storage, transportation, and other steps in the value chain, all potential sources of shortage risk are systematically listed to form the "Drug Shortage Risk Register".

blocks.zh: MAH 的可視範圍通常在貨物出售給批發商後即終止，這代表零售藥局到病患的最後一哩路資訊，往往需要倚賴其他通路夥伴提供。
blocks.en: The MAH's visibility typically ends once goods are sold to wholesalers, which means information on the last mile from retail pharmacies to patients often has to come from other channel partners.

blocks.zh: 要素 2：評估病患衝擊 — Patient Impact Assessment
blocks.en: Element 2: Assess Patient Impact - Patient Impact Assessment

blocks.zh: 根據藥品適應症，評估「哪些病患族群」會受到短缺影響，以及「影響程度為何」。此評估須書面化，並與 Section 6.2 的風險優先等級（Risk Priority Level）掛鉤。
blocks.en: Based on the drug's indications, assess "which patient populations" will be affected by a shortage and "to what degree". This assessment must be documented and linked to the Risk Priority Level in Section 6.2.

blocks.zh: 臨床風險評估（Clinical Risk Assessment）在此尤為重要，尤其是針對危重症病患或無替代療法的情境。
blocks.en: Clinical Risk Assessment is especially important here, particularly for critically ill patients or situations with no alternative therapy.

blocks.zh: 要素 3：風險控制計劃 — Short-term & Long-term
blocks.en: Element 3: Risk Control Plan - Short-term & Long-term

blocks.zh: 分為短期應急（例如：緊急庫存調配、優先排程）與長期韌性建設（例如：雙供應商策略、備用產線認證）兩個層次。
blocks.en: This has two levels: short-term emergency measures (e.g., emergency stock reallocation, priority scheduling) and long-term resilience building (e.g., dual-supplier strategy, qualification of a backup line).

blocks.zh: 此要素需回答：「萬一短缺，如何最快恢復正常供應（Return to Normal Operations）？」
blocks.en: This element must answer: "If a shortage occurs, how can we return to normal operations (Return to Normal Operations) as quickly as possible?"

blocks.zh: 要素 4：溝通計劃 — Communication Plan
blocks.en: Element 4: Communication Plan

blocks.zh: 明確定義「What（通報什麼）、Who（通報給誰）、When（何時通報）、How（如何通報）」，以及觸發溝通的條件（Triggers）。參考組織：AESGP、EFPIA、EGA、PPTA 聯合文件提供了溝通框架指引。
blocks.en: Clearly define the "What (what to report), Who (to whom), When (at what time), and How (by what means)", as well as the conditions that trigger communication (Triggers). The joint document from AESGP, EFPIA, EGA, and PPTA provides guidance on a communication framework.

blocks.zh: 要素 5：風險審查與監控 — Living Document
blocks.en: Element 5: Risk Review and Monitoring - Living Document

blocks.zh: 此計劃是「活文件」，須在產品風險輪廓（Risk Profile）發生變化時隨時更新。觸發審查的事件包括：新適應症核准、新市場進入、設施關閉、GMP 認證撤銷、庫存低於安全水位、使用量異常等。
blocks.en: The plan is a "living document" and must be updated whenever the product's risk profile (Risk Profile) changes. Events that trigger a review include approval of a new indication, entry into a new market, facility closure, withdrawal of GMP certification, inventory falling below the safety stock level, and abnormal usage.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 如何融入這五個要素？
blocks.en: Key Point: How Does the CDMO Fit into the Five Elements?

blocks.zh: 要素 1：CDMO 須主動揭露自身的製程瓶頸、設備單點失效（SPOF）風險
blocks.en: Element 1: The CDMO must proactively disclose its own process bottlenecks and equipment single point of failure (SPOF) risks

blocks.zh: 要素 3：CDMO 與 MAH 共同協商備用產能或替代製程的認證計劃
blocks.en: Element 3: The CDMO and MAH jointly agree on plans to qualify backup capacity or alternate processes

blocks.zh: 要素 5：CDMO 發生任何影響供應的事件（如設備故障、原料缺貨）時，須立即觸發計劃更新
blocks.en: Element 5: When any event affecting supply occurs at the CDMO (e.g., equipment failure, raw material stockout), a plan update must be triggered immediately

blocks.zh: 思考練習 1：CDMO 的計劃整合
blocks.en: Exercise 1: CDMO Plan Integration

blocks.zh: 假設您是 TWi Pharmaceuticals（CDMO）的品質主管。您的一位客戶 MAH 要求您協助其制定 Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan 中的「要素 3：風險控制計劃」部分。
blocks.en: Suppose you are the Quality Head at TWi Pharmaceuticals (a CDMO). One of your MAH clients asks you to help develop "Element 3: Risk Control Plan" of its Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan.

blocks.zh: 請思考：
blocks.en: Consider:

blocks.zh: 您會提供哪些 CDMO 特定的短期應急措施（例如：加班排程、庫存緩衝）？
blocks.en: What CDMO-specific short-term emergency measures would you offer (e.g., overtime scheduling, inventory buffers)?

blocks.zh: 您會提出哪些長期韌性建設方案（例如：備用供應商、次要產線認證）？
blocks.en: What long-term resilience-building options would you propose (e.g., backup suppliers, qualification of a secondary line)?

blocks.zh: 如果 CDMO 端發生設備故障，觸發「要素 5」審查，通報流程應如何設計？
blocks.en: If equipment fails at the CDMO and triggers the "Element 5" review, how should the notification process be designed?

blocks.zh: 循環流程圖與端對端價值鏈示意圖
blocks.en: Cycle Diagram and End-to-End Value Chain Diagram

blocks.zh: 中文解析：循環機制的意義
blocks.en: Commentary: The Meaning of the Cycle

blocks.zh: 這是一個「閉環（Closed Loop）」系統
blocks.en: This Is a "Closed Loop" System

blocks.zh: 五個步驟並非線性流程，而是持續循環：步驟 5「審查與監控」的結果，直接觸發步驟 1「重新識別危害」，形成持續改善的閉環機制。
blocks.en: The five steps are not a linear process but a continuous cycle: the output of Step 5, "Review and Monitoring", directly triggers Step 1, "Re-identify Hazards", forming a closed loop of continual improvement.

blocks.zh: 這與 PDCA（Plan-Do-Check-Act）循環的精神一致，也與 ICH Q9(R1) 風險管理的生命週期方法相呼應。
blocks.en: This is consistent with the spirit of the PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act) cycle and also echoes the lifecycle approach to risk management in ICH Q9(R1).

blocks.zh: 比喻：緊急應變小組（ERT）定期演練
blocks.en: Analogy: Regular Drills by the Emergency Response Team (ERT)

blocks.zh: 工廠的緊急應變小組（Emergency Response Team, ERT）不只在火災發生時才啟動，而是定期演練、更新疏散圖、重新確認人員角色。Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan 的五步驟循環，就像 ERT 的「年度演練 → 更新應變計劃 → 再演練」程序——平時的準備決定危機時的應對品質。
blocks.en: A plant's Emergency Response Team (ERT) is not activated only when a fire breaks out; it runs regular drills, updates evacuation maps, and reconfirms personnel roles. The five-step cycle of the Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan is like the ERT's "annual drill → update response plan → drill again" routine: preparation in normal times determines the quality of the response in a crisis.

blocks.zh: 步驟 5 的觸發條件清單
blocks.en: List of Step 5 Trigger Conditions

blocks.zh: 以下任一事件發生，均應觸發計劃審查：
blocks.en: Any of the following events should trigger a plan review:

blocks.zh: 獲批新適應症或進入新市場
blocks.en: Approval of a new indication or entry into a new market

blocks.zh: 新替代產品或未授權替代品核准上市
blocks.en: Approval of a new alternative product or an unlicensed substitute

blocks.zh: 替代產品本身發生短缺
blocks.en: A shortage of the alternative product itself

blocks.zh: 產品品質或可得性出現新風險
blocks.en: New risks to product quality or availability

blocks.zh: 製造設施關閉或 GMP 認證/上市許可（MA）撤銷
blocks.en: Closure of the manufacturing facility, or withdrawal of GMP certification or marketing authorization (MA)

blocks.zh: 庫存跌破安全庫存水位目標
blocks.en: Inventory falling below the target safety stock level

blocks.zh: 使用量發生顯著變化
blocks.en: A significant change in usage

blocks.zh: 端對端價值鏈（從原料到病患）
blocks.en: End-to-End Value Chain (from Raw Materials to Patients)

blocks.zh: 中文解析：價值鏈中的 CDMO 定位
blocks.en: Commentary: The CDMO's Position in the Value Chain

blocks.zh: CDMO 在價值鏈中的位置
blocks.en: The CDMO's Position in the Value Chain

blocks.zh: CDMO 通常承接Drug Substance（原料藥）、Drug Product（藥品製劑）、Packaging（包裝）等節點的委託製造業務。這意味著：
blocks.en: A CDMO typically takes on contract manufacturing for nodes such as Drug Substance, Drug Product, and Packaging. This means:

blocks.zh: CDMO 的製程中斷，可直接影響 3 個關鍵節點
blocks.en: A disruption in the CDMO's process can directly affect 3 key nodes

blocks.zh: CDMO 發生問題，MAH 對下游（Wholesaler → Patient）的供應影響可能是連鎖性的
blocks.en: When a problem occurs at the CDMO, the impact on the MAH's downstream supply (Wholesaler → Patient) may cascade

blocks.zh: CDMO 必須對 MAH 保持高度透明，提供即時的供應狀態回報
blocks.en: The CDMO must remain highly transparent to the MAH and provide real-time supply status reporting

blocks.zh: MAH 的可視性邊界
blocks.en: The MAH's Visibility Boundary

blocks.zh: 根據 TR68 原文，「Typical visibility for a MAH ends after shipment to wholesale distributors.」
blocks.en: According to the original text of TR68, "Typical visibility for a MAH ends after shipment to wholesale distributors."

blocks.zh: 這代表 MAH 通常無法直接監控零售藥局、醫院藥局及病患端的庫存狀況。因此，Pharmacy 與 Patient 節點的資訊，需透過批發商或地區聯繫機構（Affiliates）回饋，形成資訊缺口（Information Gap）。
blocks.en: This means the MAH usually cannot directly monitor inventory at retail pharmacies, hospital pharmacies, or the patient end. Information for the Pharmacy and Patient nodes therefore has to be fed back through wholesalers or regional affiliates (Affiliates), creating an information gap (Information Gap).

blocks.zh: 比喻：供應鏈如同「水管系統」
blocks.en: Analogy: The Supply Chain Is Like a "Plumbing System"

blocks.zh: 從原料到病患，就像水從源頭流向用戶。CDMO 是供水管網中的主要加壓站——若加壓站出問題，不論下游管線多完善，最終用戶（病患）仍會斷水。因此，CDMO 的穩健性直接決定了整條供應鏈的韌性。
blocks.en: From raw materials to patients is like water flowing from the source to the users. The CDMO is a major pressure-boosting station in the supply network: if the station fails, no matter how well-built the downstream pipes are, the end users (patients) will still lose their water. The robustness of the CDMO therefore directly determines the resilience of the entire supply chain.

blocks.zh: 利害關係人管理與藥品短缺溝通 — 法規義務與協作對話
blocks.en: Stakeholder Management and Drug Shortage Communication: Regulatory Obligations and Collaborative Dialog

blocks.zh: 中文解析：法規義務與協作精神
blocks.en: Commentary: Regulatory Obligations and the Spirit of Collaboration

blocks.zh: 比喻：緊急應變小組（ERT）啟動 — 協作而非單向通報
blocks.en: Analogy: Activating the Emergency Response Team (ERT): Collaboration, Not One-Way Notification

blocks.zh: 傳統觀念認為「通報衛生主管機關」是單向的合規動作。TR68 強調的是「協作對話（Collaborative Dialog）」，更像工廠 ERT 啟動後，消防隊、廠務、安全人員共同指揮的場景——每個角色有各自專業，但共同目標是將危害最小化。
blocks.en: The traditional view is that "notifying the health authority" is a one-way compliance action. TR68 emphasizes "Collaborative Dialog", which is more like the scene after a plant's ERT is activated, when the fire brigade, facilities staff, and safety personnel command together: each role has its own expertise, but the shared goal is to minimize harm.

blocks.zh: 與衛生主管機關建立這種「夥伴關係」，遠比事後被動應對來得更有效率。
blocks.en: Building this kind of "partnership" with health authorities is far more efficient than responding passively after the fact.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：何時必須通報？
blocks.en: Key Point: When Is Notification Required?

blocks.zh: 觸發通報的條件是：「因製造或品質問題，可能發生有意義的供應中斷（meaningful disruption），即無法正常配送正常量」時。
blocks.en: The notification trigger is: when a "meaningful disruption" in supply may occur due to a manufacturing or quality problem, i.e., the inability to distribute normal quantities as usual.

blocks.zh: 風險矩陣（Table 6.1.1-1🔍）按照療效分類與替代療法可得性，分層決定通報的緊迫程度（Risk Level A / B / C）。
blocks.en: The risk matrix (Table 6.1.1-1🔍) tiers the urgency of notification (Risk Level A / B / C) according to the therapeutic classification and the availability of alternative therapies.

blocks.zh: 缺陷產品的特殊情境：臨床利益 vs. 短缺風險
blocks.en: Special Situation of Defective Products: Clinical Benefit vs. Shortage Risk

blocks.zh: 當一個產品存在潛在品質缺陷（例如：無菌保證不足），但完全沒有替代療法時，TR68 要求進行「臨床利益與風險比較」（Clinical Benefit vs. Risk Comparison）：
blocks.en: When a product has a potential quality defect (e.g., inadequate sterility assurance) but there is no alternative therapy at all, TR68 requires a "Clinical Benefit vs. Risk Comparison":

blocks.zh: 繼續使用：可能有品質風險，但病患至少有藥可用
blocks.en: Continue use: there may be a quality risk, but patients at least have a drug available

blocks.zh: 停止供應：確保無品質風險，但病患可能面臨更嚴重的治療中斷
blocks.en: Stop supply: ensures no quality risk, but patients may face a more serious interruption of treatment

blocks.zh: 此決定需由公司與衛生主管機關共同協商，而非單方面決定。
blocks.en: This decision must be jointly negotiated between the company and the health authority, not made unilaterally.

blocks.zh: 兩大法規通報義務對照
blocks.en: Comparison of the Two Regulatory Notification Obligations

blocks.zh: 注意：這些法規針對 MAH，而非 CDMO。但 CDMO 必須確保能及時向 MAH 提供通報所需的相關資訊。
blocks.en: Note: These regulations apply to the MAH, not the CDMO. However, the CDMO must ensure it can promptly provide the MAH with the information needed for notification.

blocks.zh: 向衛生主管機關提交的關鍵風險指示資訊
blocks.en: Key Risk-Indicating Information to Submit to the Health Authority

blocks.zh: 中文解析：CDMO 應維護的資訊清單
blocks.en: Commentary: Information Checklist the CDMO Should Maintain

blocks.zh: 通報責任分層（Communication Accountability）
blocks.en: Communication Accountability

blocks.zh: TR68 明確要求釐清通報責任鏈：
blocks.en: TR68 explicitly requires clarifying the notification accountability chain:

blocks.zh: 製造商/首個配銷商（即 CDMO 或 MAH 自有工廠）
blocks.en: Manufacturer / first distributor (i.e., the CDMO or the MAH's own plant)

blocks.zh: 批發商、代理商、再包裝商
blocks.en: Wholesalers, agents, and repackagers

blocks.zh: 末端供應者（零售藥局、醫院藥局、醫師）
blocks.en: End suppliers (retail pharmacies, hospital pharmacies, physicians)

blocks.zh: CDMO 屬於第 1 層，須確保第 1 層的資訊完整、正確，作為 MAH 向衛生主管機關通報的基礎。
blocks.en: The CDMO belongs to Tier 1 and must ensure that Tier 1 information is complete and accurate, as the basis for the MAH's notification to the health authority.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應維護的三類資訊清單
blocks.en: Three Categories of Information the CDMO Should Maintain

blocks.zh: A. 病患相關資訊（Patient-Related）
blocks.en: A. Patient-Related Information

blocks.zh: 本產品的主要適應症與目標病患族群說明
blocks.en: Description of the product's main indications and target patient populations

blocks.zh: 月處方量（Monthly Prescription Volume）估計
blocks.en: Estimated Monthly Prescription Volume

blocks.zh: 特殊脆弱族群識別（如新生兒、癌症病患、糖尿病病患）
blocks.en: Identification of particularly vulnerable populations (e.g., neonates, cancer patients, diabetic patients)

blocks.zh: B. 配銷資訊（Distribution Information）
blocks.en: B. Distribution Information

blocks.zh: 主要批發商名稱與地址
blocks.en: Names and addresses of the main wholesalers

blocks.zh: 次要批發商清單（若有）
blocks.en: List of secondary wholesalers (if any)

blocks.zh: 供應通路說明（醫院 vs. 零售 vs. 診所）
blocks.en: Description of supply channels (hospital vs. retail vs. clinic)

blocks.zh: 平行進口可能性評估（各市場法規不同）
blocks.en: Assessment of the possibility of parallel imports (regulations differ by market)

blocks.zh: C. 庫存資訊（Current Stock）
blocks.en: C. Current Stock

blocks.zh: 目前庫存量（各市場/倉庫）
blocks.en: Current stock quantity (by market/warehouse)

blocks.zh: 預計庫存耗盡日期
blocks.en: Projected stock depletion date

blocks.zh: 現有庫存是否足以滿足病患需求
blocks.en: Whether current stock is sufficient to meet patient demand

blocks.zh: 是否有政府要求的戰備儲量
blocks.en: Whether a government-mandated emergency reserve exists

blocks.zh: 公式：庫存天數計算（Days of Supply）
blocks.en: Formula: Calculating Days of Supply

blocks.zh:
庫存天數（Days of Supply）
= 現有庫存量（Current Inventory）
  ÷ 每日消耗率（Daily Consumption Rate）

其中：
  每日消耗率 = 月銷售量（Monthly Sales Volume） ÷ 30

範例：
  現有庫存 = 150,000 單位
  月銷售量 = 30,000 單位
  每日消耗率 = 30,000 ÷ 30 = 1,000 單位/天
  庫存天數 = 150,000 ÷ 1,000 = 150 天
blocks.en:
Days of Supply
= Current Inventory
  ÷ Daily Consumption Rate

Where:
  Daily Consumption Rate = Monthly Sales Volume ÷ 30

Example:
  Current Inventory = 150,000 units
  Monthly Sales Volume = 30,000 units
  Daily Consumption Rate = 30,000 ÷ 30 = 1,000 units/day
  Days of Supply = 150,000 ÷ 1,000 = 150 days

blocks.zh: CDMO 應在系統中定期計算各產品的庫存天數，當天數低於警戒水位（例如：30 天或 60 天）時，自動觸發通報流程。
blocks.en: The CDMO should regularly calculate Days of Supply for each product in its system and automatically trigger the notification process when the number of days falls below an alert level (e.g., 30 or 60 days).

blocks.zh: 思考練習 2：庫存天數警報設計
blocks.en: Exercise 2: Designing a Days-of-Supply Alert

blocks.zh: 您正在為一個 Risk Priority Level 1 的藥品設計庫存監控警報系統。假設生命支持用藥的監管要求是至少保持 90 天庫存。
blocks.en: You are designing an inventory monitoring alert system for a Risk Priority Level 1 drug. Assume the regulatory requirement for life-supporting drugs is to maintain at least 90 days of stock.

blocks.zh: 請計算以下情境的庫存天數，並判斷是否需要通報：
blocks.en: Calculate the Days of Supply for the following scenarios and decide whether notification is required:

blocks.zh: 參考答案：A = 90天（剛好達標，建議觀察）；B = 50天（低於90天，需通報）；C = 45天（低於90天，需通報）
blocks.en: Reference answer: A = 90 days (just meets the requirement; recommend monitoring); B = 50 days (below 90 days; notification required); C = 45 days (below 90 days; notification required)

blocks.zh: 公司與衛生主管機關的風險決策框架
blocks.en: Risk Decision Framework for the Company and the Health Authority

blocks.zh: 中文解析：四大 HA 決策節點
blocks.en: Commentary: The Four HA Decision Points

blocks.zh: CAPA 所有權的擴展
blocks.en: Expanding CAPA Ownership

blocks.zh: TR68 特別指出：CAPA 的所有者不應只是製造商或 MAH，可能還需要包含供應鏈中其他利害關係人。例如：
blocks.en: TR68 specifically notes: the owner of a CAPA should not be only the manufacturer or MAH; it may also need to include other stakeholders in the supply chain. For example:

blocks.zh: 地區附屬機構（Affiliates）負責當地庫存調配的 CAPA
blocks.en: Regional affiliates (Affiliates) own CAPA for local inventory allocation

blocks.zh: 配銷中心負責物流優化的 CAPA
blocks.en: Distribution centers own CAPA for logistics optimization

blocks.zh: 藥局負責藥物替換諮詢的 CAPA
blocks.en: Pharmacies own CAPA for drug substitution counseling

blocks.zh: CDMO 也可能需要承擔部分 CAPA 所有權，尤其是當短缺根因在於 CDMO 端的製程問題時。
blocks.en: The CDMO may also need to take on part of CAPA ownership, especially when the root cause of the shortage lies in a process problem at the CDMO.

blocks.zh: 比喻：「缺陷產品 vs. 無產品」的艱難抉擇
blocks.en: Analogy: The Hard Choice Between "Defective Product vs. No Product"

blocks.zh: 想像急診室只剩下一批「標示可能有誤」的 Epinephrine（腎上腺素）注射劑，但沒有任何替代品。醫師面臨的選擇是：用這批有標示風險的藥救治過敏性休克病患，還是什麼都不做？
blocks.en: Imagine an emergency room with only one batch of Epinephrine injection left, "labeled with a possible error", and no alternative. The physician's choice is: use this batch, with its labeling risk, to treat a patient in anaphylactic shock, or do nothing at all?

blocks.zh: TR68 的 HA Decision Point 4 正是處理這種「使用缺陷產品的臨床利益是否大於短缺帶來的傷害」情境。這個決定不應由製造商單獨做出，必須是公司與衛生主管機關共同協商的結果。
blocks.en: TR68's HA Decision Point 4 addresses exactly this situation: "whether the clinical benefit of using a defective product outweighs the harm caused by the shortage". This decision should not be made by the manufacturer alone; it must be the result of joint negotiation between the company and the health authority.

blocks.zh: HA Decision Point 3 的 CDMO 實務影響
blocks.en: Practical Implications of HA Decision Point 3 for the CDMO

blocks.zh: 當 MAH 向衛生主管機關申請「加速使用備用未授權設施（Alternate Unlicensed Facility）」時，CDMO 可能就是那個「備用設施」。這意味著：
blocks.en: When the MAH asks the health authority for "expedited use of an Alternate Unlicensed Facility", the CDMO may be that "alternate facility". This means:

blocks.zh: CDMO 須預先準備好接受衛生主管機關的緊急查廠或文件審查
blocks.en: The CDMO must be prepared in advance to accept an urgent inspection or document review by the health authority

blocks.zh: CDMO 與 MAH 的合約中，應明確規範緊急狀況下的快速授權流程
blocks.en: The contract between the CDMO and MAH should clearly specify the expedited authorization process for emergency situations

blocks.zh: 批准可能是「有條件（Conditional）」或「臨時（Temporary）」的，CDMO 須了解相應義務
blocks.en: Approval may be "Conditional" or "Temporary", and the CDMO must understand the corresponding obligations

blocks.zh: 短缺事件是改善機會（Continuous Improvement）
blocks.en: A Shortage Event Is an Opportunity for Improvement (Continuous Improvement)

blocks.zh: TR68 結語特別強調：每次短缺事件都應被視為組織審查風險登記冊、更新風險控制計劃的機會。具體行動包括：
blocks.en: The TR68 conclusion specifically emphasizes: every shortage event should be treated as an opportunity for the organization to review the risk register and update the risk control plan. Specific actions include:

blocks.zh: 深入調查短缺的真正根本原因（True Root Cause）
blocks.en: Investigate in depth the true root cause of the shortage (True Root Cause)

blocks.zh: 修訂 CAPA，防止相似產品再度發生短缺
blocks.en: Revise CAPA to prevent shortages of similar products from recurring

blocks.zh: 識別並修補本次短缺事件所揭露的系統缺口（Gaps）
blocks.en: Identify and close the system gaps (Gaps) exposed by this shortage event

blocks.zh: 這一原則與 ICH Q10 中持續改善（Continual Improvement）的精神完全吻合。
blocks.en: This principle fully aligns with the spirit of Continual Improvement in ICH Q10.

blocks.zh: Section 4 Summary — 本節重點回顧
blocks.en: Section 4 Summary: Key Points Review

blocks.zh: 7.0 五步驟循環：Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan 由「識別危害 → 評估病患衝擊 → 風險控制計劃（短期+長期）→ 溝通計劃 → 審查與監控」五個步驟構成，是持續循環的活文件，應在衛生主管機關稽查時主動分享。
blocks.en: 7.0 Five-step cycle: The Drug Shortage Prevention and Response Plan consists of five steps: "identify hazards → assess patient impact → risk control plan (short-term + long-term) → communication plan → review and monitoring". It is a continuously cycling living document and should be proactively shared during health authority inspections.

blocks.zh: 7.0 E2E 價值鏈：從原料 → 原料藥 → 藥品製劑 → 包裝 → 倉儲配送 → 關係企業 → 批發商 → 藥局 → 病患。CDMO 通常涵蓋前三至四個節點，是供應鏈的關鍵風險集中點；MAH 的直接可視範圍通常止於批發商。
blocks.en: 7.0 E2E value chain: From raw materials → drug substance → drug product → packaging → warehousing and distribution → affiliates → wholesalers → pharmacies → patients. The CDMO typically covers the first three to four nodes and is a critical risk concentration point in the supply chain; the MAH's direct visibility usually ends at the wholesaler.

blocks.zh: 8.0 法規義務：MAH 依法須通報衛生主管機關（EU: Directive 2003/94/EC Art.13 + EU GMP §5.71；US: FD&C Act §506C）。通報精神是「協作對話（Collaborative Dialog）」，而非被動的單向通知。
blocks.en: 8.0 Regulatory obligations: The MAH is legally required to notify the health authority (EU: Directive 2003/94/EC Art.13 + EU GMP §5.71; US: FD&C Act §506C). The spirit of notification is "Collaborative Dialog", not passive one-way notice.

blocks.zh: 8.1 三類關鍵資訊：向衛生主管機關通報時需備妥（1）病患相關資訊（族群、規模、影響百分比）、（2）配銷資訊（通路、批發商、替代進口可能性）、（3）庫存資訊（現有庫存量、耗盡日期）。CDMO 應建立系統化維護機制，庫存天數 = 現有庫存 ÷ 每日消耗率。
blocks.en: 8.1 Three categories of key information: Prepare the following for notification to the health authority: (1) patient-related information (populations, scale, percentage affected), (2) distribution information (channels, wholesalers, possibility of alternative imports), and (3) stock information (current stock quantity, depletion date). The CDMO should establish a systematic maintenance mechanism; Days of Supply = current inventory ÷ daily consumption rate.

blocks.zh: 8.2 四大 HA 決策點：①正式介入程度、②替代供應來源（含他市場版本進口）、③加速監管審批（有條件/臨時/永久）、④溝通策略（含缺陷產品繼續使用的臨床利益風險衡量）。每次短缺都是更新風險登記冊的改善機會。
blocks.en: 8.2 Four HA decision points: (1) level of formal involvement, (2) alternative supply sources (including importing versions from other markets), (3) expedited regulatory approval (conditional / temporary / permanent), and (4) communication strategy (including the clinical benefit-risk weighing of continued use of a defective product). Every shortage is an opportunity for improvement by updating the risk register.

blocks.zh: CDMO 核心責任：積極貢獻各要素的 CDMO 端資訊、維護庫存透明度、預先準備緊急稽查就緒狀態，並在合約中明確規範緊急授權流程。
blocks.en: Core CDMO responsibilities: Actively contribute CDMO-side information for each element, maintain inventory transparency, prepare in advance to be ready for urgent inspections, and clearly specify the emergency authorization process in the contract.
